# API contracts: Feature settings

Each endpoint in the spec 29.5 template. Shared rules (errors, idempotency, versions, versioning): [API contracts guide](../README.md). Index: [all endpoints](README.md).

### GET /api/v1/features/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `features_list` |
| Method and path | `GET /api/v1/features/` |
| Business purpose | Every feature with its default and settings. With ``?facility=``: per-facility features only, with that facility's settings. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-ORG-004](../../../requirements/organization-and-facilities.md#hims-org-004) |
| Actor / permission required | `features.view` (See which features are on for the hospital and each facility). System roles holding it: Organization administrator, Facility (branch) administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session |
| Customer / facility scope | Facility or department: a grant at one facility or department is enough; rows outside it stay hidden (404) |
| Request schema | No body; query: `facility` |
| Response schema | 200 list of `FeatureState` |
| Validation rules | Query values outside the allowed ones are refused (400) or ignored |
| Allowed current states | Any |
| Resulting state | Unchanged (read only) |
| Idempotency key behavior | Not applicable (read only) |
| Concurrency control | None needed (read only) |
| Database transaction | Read only |
| Audit event | None of its own (reads of configuration are not audited; a refusal records `access.denied`) |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request |
| Expected error codes | 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | `apps/features/tests/test_features.py::test_planned_and_other_country_features_cannot_be_switched_on`, `apps/features/tests/test_features.py::test_admin_sees_every_feature_and_changes_one`, `apps/features/tests/test_features.py::test_facility_admin_changes_only_own_facility`, `apps/features/tests/test_features.py::test_staff_without_permission_cannot_see_settings` |
| Backward-compatibility policy | API v1 rules in [the API contracts guide](../README.md#versioning-and-breaking-changes); CI fails when `docs/api/openapi.yaml` differs from the code |

### POST /api/v1/features/{key}/change/

| Field | Contract |
|---|---|
| Endpoint ID | `features_change` |
| Method and path | `POST /api/v1/features/{key}/change/` |
| Business purpose | Turn a feature on, off or back to the default, for the hospital or one facility. |
| Requirements | [HIMS-ORG-004](../../../requirements/organization-and-facilities.md#hims-org-004) |
| Actor / permission required | `features.manage` (Turn features on or off for the hospital or a facility). System roles holding it: Organization administrator, Facility (branch) administrator. Privileged roles must have passed two-factor in this session; a "confirm it's you" within the last 15 minutes is required |
| Customer / facility scope | Facility or department: a grant at one facility or department is enough; rows outside it stay hidden (404) |
| Request schema | `FeatureChangeRequest`: `facility` (uuid), `setting` (required, one of the listed values), `reason` (required, ≤ 255 characters), `version` (required) |
| Response schema | 200 `FeatureState` |
| Validation rules | Fields as in the request schema; anything invalid is 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` with each field's problem, and nothing is saved |
| Allowed current states | Any (no state rule) |
| Resulting state | As in the purpose above; the new state is in the response and the audit event |
| Idempotency key behavior | `Idempotency-Key` header (optional; operation `features.change`): the same key with the same body replays the stored answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`); with a different body 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; kept 48 hours |
| Concurrency control | Send the `version` you read; if the record changed since, 409 `STALE_RESOURCE` and nothing is saved; the row is locked while it changes, so two requests never both win |
| Database transaction | One transaction: the change, its audit event and any background event are saved together or not at all |
| Audit event | `feature.flag.changed` |
| Outbox / domain event | None |
| External calls | None |
| Timeout and retry policy | No outside calls inside the request; the client may retry a lost answer with the same Idempotency-Key |
| Expected error codes | 400 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, 400 `INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`, 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, 401 `NOT_AUTHENTICATED`, 403 `MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED`, 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, 403 `REAUTH_REQUIRED`, 404 `NOT_FOUND`, 409 `CONFLICT`, 409 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, 409 `STALE_RESOURCE`, 409 `UNKNOWN_FEATURE`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| Rate / volume assumptions | not signed in: 60/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_ANON`); signed in: 1200/min per address (`HIMS_THROTTLE_USER`) |
| Metrics and alerts | Request log line and trace span with `request_id`, status and time; response-time targets checked by the volume check (HIMS-OPS-017); hosted alarms with HIMS-OPS-004 |
| Automated test cases | Covered through the screen's browser tests and the requirement's tests (see record) |
| Backward-compatibility policy | API v1 rules in [the API contracts guide](../README.md#versioning-and-breaking-changes); CI fails when `docs/api/openapi.yaml` differs from the code |
